canonical_project: Incheon International Airport Aviation AI Innovation Hub data center
owner: Incheon International Airport Corporation / CT Development consortium / LG CNS / Korea Investment & Securities
notes: Incheon International Airport Corp. selected the CT Development consortium as preferred bidder for a KRW 600bn aviation AI innovation hub. Reports describe a 5 MW GPU farm and 40 MW-class AI data center in the airport's Second International Business District near Terminal 2, with completion targeted around 2028; the airport is in Jung-gu.
